why: [R-COC-02] with the ratchet of [R-ENF-02]. Every study carrying a cost-of-capital record on the day the rule was adopted (07-09-2026) predates it and declares no terminal construction. Each entry names WHAT THE RECORD ACTUALLY REPRODUCES UNDER, because the fix is a single declared field rather than a rebuild and an entry that names the fix is an entry somebody can close. NONE of these is a wrong number: all five reproduce exactly, three under same_beta and two under a Hamada relevering at 22.50%. What is outstanding is that the record does not SAY WHICH, so a reader cannot tell a relevered beta from a typo and neither could any instrument. The list may only ever get SHORTER (--prune). [R-ENF-08, 07-09-2026]: each entry now carries the SIGNATURE of the failure it excuses. A ratchet entry is a ticker, so before this a listed study was excused from the whole gate and could acquire a SECOND, DIFFERENT defect of the same class unseen — which the injection harness demonstrated by planting a stale land base in a study already listed and being ignored. Comparison is on the failure's SHAPE with live figures stripped, because an exact-text match would go red every time a date moved.
